bellow--verb.def: To shout in a deep loud voice.
bellow--verb.exTr: Usta başı bir emri gürleyerek verdi.

untreated--adj.def: Not given medical care, or not chemically processed.

temperate--adj.def: Never very hot and never very cold.
temperate--adj.ex: The coast has a temperate climate.

footnote--noun.def: A short note at the bottom of a page.
footnote--noun.ex: The source is given in a footnote.

dignify--verb.def: To make something seem more worthy of respect.
dignify--verb.ex: Do not dignify that claim with an answer.
dignify--verb.exTr: Bu iddiaya cevap vererek değer katma.

prance--noun.def: A lively springing movement, as a horse makes.
prance--noun.ex: The colt crossed the field at a prance.

perspiration--noun.def: The liquid that comes from the skin when you are hot.

impressionist--noun.def: An artist of the style that shows light and quick effects.

undergraduate--noun.def: A university student who has not yet taken a first degree.
undergraduate--noun.ex: She is an undergraduate in Ankara.

emphatically--adv.def: In a strong and definite way.

dissatisfaction--noun.def: The feeling of not being pleased with something.

worsen--verb.def: To become worse, or to make something worse.

bombard--noun.def: A heavy continuous attack with guns.

astonishment--noun.def: A feeling of very great surprise.

improperly--adv.def: In a way that is wrong or not allowed.

cyberspace--noun.def: The imagined space where online communication happens.

elegantly--adv.def: In a graceful and attractive way.

rectangular--adj.ex: The table is long and rectangular.

authoritative--adj.def: Trusted as accurate, or showing confident power.

suitably--adv.def: In a way that fits the occasion.

engulf--verb.def: To surround and cover something completely.

bad-tempered--adj.ex: He is bad tempered in the morning.

ravage--noun.ex: The ravage of the war is visible.

overstep--verb.def: To go beyond what is allowed.

pallet--noun.def: A flat wooden frame used for moving goods.
pallet--noun.ex: The boxes sit on a pallet.

outdo--verb.def: To do something better than someone else.

spellbound--adj.def: So interested that you cannot look away.

malady--noun.def: An illness, or a serious problem in society.

heartwarming--adj.def: Making you feel happy and hopeful.

forestry--noun.def: The science of planting and caring for forests.

gaiety--noun.ex: The gaiety of the festival lifted us.

diphtheria--noun.def: A serious infectious disease of the throat.

sexism--noun.def: Unfair treatment of people because of their sex.
sexism--noun.ex: The report examines sexism at work.

additionally--adv.def: As an extra point, in addition.

absentee--noun.def: A person who is not present when expected.

paintbrush--noun.def: A brush used for putting on paint.

equip--verb.def: To supply a place or a person with what is needed.
equip--verb.ex: They equipped the lab with new tools.

microbe--noun.def: A living thing too small to see that can cause illness.
microbe--noun.ex: The microbe survives in cold water.

pawnbroker--noun.def: A person who lends money for goods left as security.

unsatisfactory--adj.def: Not good enough for what is needed.

shoplifter--noun.def: A person who steals goods from a shop.
shoplifter--noun.ex: A shoplifter was caught at the door.

atypical--adj.def: Not like the usual example of its kind.

spreadsheet--noun.def: A computer program for working with rows of numbers.
spreadsheet--noun.ex: Enter the data in a spreadsheet.

prominence--noun.def: The state of being important and well known.

tactile--adj.def: Relating to the sense of touch.

motorist--noun.def: A person who drives a car.

dissident--noun.def: A person who openly opposes their government.

visibly--adv.def: In a way that is easy to see.

theorist--noun.def: A person who develops ideas to explain something.

seesaw--noun.def: A long board children sit on at each end to go up and down.

soybean--noun.def: A bean used for oil and for animal food.

reorganize--verb.def: To change how something is arranged or run.

impatiently--adv.def: In a way that shows you do not want to wait.

broadband--noun.def: A fast connection to the internet.

outwardly--adv.def: In the way something seems on the outside.

walkabout--noun.def: A walk among ordinary people by an important person.
walkabout--noun.ex: The mayor went on a walkabout.
walkabout--noun.exTr: Belediye başkanı halk arasında gezintiye çıktı.

paratrooper--noun.def: A soldier trained to jump from planes.
paratrooper--noun.ex: A paratrooper landed in the field.

tiredness--noun.def: The state of needing rest or sleep.

shakespearean--adj.def: Relating to the writer Shakespeare or his plays.

retailer--noun.def: A shop or a company that sells to the public.

densely--adv.def: With things or people very close together.

well-built--adj.def: Strong and solid in body or construction.
well-built--adj.ex: He is a well built young man.

orator--noun.def: A person who makes powerful public speeches.

outgrow--verb.def: To become too big or too old for something.

stopover--noun.def: A short stay between two parts of a journey.
stopover--noun.ex: We had a stopover in Doha.

anchorman--noun.def: A man who presents a television news programme.

cellist--noun.def: A person who plays the cello.

familiarize--verb.def: To make someone know something well.

salesperson--noun.def: A person whose job is selling goods.
salesperson--noun.ex: A salesperson showed us the models.
salesperson--noun.exTr: Bir satış görevlisi bize modelleri gösterdi.

skillfully--adv.def: In a way that shows great ability.

uncomfortably--adv.def: In a way that is not comfortable or not easy.

bookmark--noun.def: Something that marks your place in a book or a website.
bookmark--noun.ex: She keeps a ribbon as a bookmark.
